title: RumVitalWebsocketCommonProperties
description: Schema of common properties for a WebSocket vital event. One connection reports a stream of vitals over its lifetime, one per phase, all sharing the same vital.websocket.id

name.description: Name of the vital, identifying the phase of the connection it reports: websocket_connecting, websocket_open, websocket_closing or websocket_closed

id.description: UUID of the WebSocket connection, stable across every vital reported for that connection. It is not vital.id, which identifies a single vital
